existing_fee_payment_rules.legal_concept: Fees reasonably calculated to reimburse actual cost
existing_fee_payment_rules.atomic_rule: A public body may establish fees reasonably calculated to reimburse it for its actual cost of making public records available, including costs for summarizing, compiling or tailoring the records in organization or media to meet the request.
existing_fee_payment_rules.trigger: Public body makes records available in response to a request
existing_fee_payment_rules.source_language: The public body may establish fees reasonably calculated to reimburse the public body for the public body's actual cost of making public records available, including costs for summarizing, compiling or tailoring the public records, either in organization or media, to meet the request.
existing_fee_payment_rules.notes: No statewide fixed per-page or per-hour rate; the ceiling is the soft 'actual cost / reasonably calculated' standard and the city supplies the operative rates.

existing_fee_payment_rules.legal_concept: Attorney review/redaction time in fees; exclusion of exemption-analysis time
existing_fee_payment_rules.atomic_rule: A public body may include in the fee the cost of attorney time spent reviewing, redacting, or segregating records into exempt and nonexempt, but may NOT include attorney time spent determining the application of ORS 192.311 to 192.478.
existing_fee_payment_rules.trigger: Attorney time expended on a request
existing_fee_payment_rules.source_language: The public body may include in a fee established under paragraph (a) of this subsection the cost of time spent by an attorney for the public body in reviewing the public records, redacting material from the public records or segregating the public records into exempt and nonexempt records. The public body may not include in a fee established under paragraph (a) of this subsection the cost of time spent by an attorney for the public body in determining the application of the provisions of ORS 192.311 to 192.478.
existing_fee_payment_rules.notes: Conjunctive permission+prohibition kept in one row (the includable/not-includable line is a single fee-component rule). Drives fee composition.

existing_fee_payment_rules.legal_concept: $25 fee threshold requiring written estimate and confirmation
existing_fee_payment_rules.atomic_rule: A public body may not establish a fee greater than $25 unless it first provides the requester written notification of the estimated fee amount and the requester confirms that it wants the public body to proceed.
existing_fee_payment_rules.source_language: The public body may not establish a fee greater than $25 under this section unless the public body first provides the requester with a written notification of the estimated amount of the fee and the requester confirms that the requester wants the public body to proceed with making the public record available.
existing_fee_payment_rules.notes: $25 is the fixed trigger value; the estimate-and-confirm step is a structural gate that pairs with the fee-suspension clock (OR-0024). City cannot raise the $25 trigger.

existing_fee_payment_rules.legal_concept: Discretionary fee waiver or reduction in the public interest
existing_fee_payment_rules.atomic_rule: The custodian may furnish copies without charge or at a substantially reduced fee if it determines the waiver or reduction is in the public interest because making the record available primarily benefits the general public.
existing_fee_payment_rules.trigger: Custodian determines waiver/reduction is in the public interest
existing_fee_payment_rules.source_language: The custodian of a public record may furnish copies without charge or at a substantially reduced fee if the custodian determines that the waiver or reduction of fees is in the public interest because making the record available primarily benefits the general public.
existing_fee_payment_rules.notes: Discretionary branch; denial of a waiver is separately reviewable (OR-0025).

existing_fee_payment_rules.legal_concept: Response obligation suspended pending fee payment
existing_fee_payment_rules.atomic_rule: If the public body has informed the requester of a permitted fee, its obligation to complete the response is suspended until the fee is paid, waived by the body, or ordered waived.
existing_fee_payment_rules.trigger: Public body informs requester of a fee under ORS 192.324(4)
existing_fee_payment_rules.clock_spec: completion obligation tolled from date requester is informed of fee until fee paid or waived
existing_fee_payment_rules.source_language: If a public body has informed a requester of a fee permitted under ORS 192.324 (Copies or inspection of public records) (4), the obligation of the public body to complete its response to the request is suspended until the requester has paid the fee, the fee has been waived by the public body pursuant to ORS 192.324 (Copies or inspection of public records) (5) or the fee otherwise has been ordered waived.
existing_fee_payment_rules.notes: Tolls the soft completion duty (OR-0009) while fee is outstanding.

existing_fee_payment_rules.legal_concept: Close of request after 60 days' nonpayment
existing_fee_payment_rules.atomic_rule: If the requester fails to pay the fee within 60 days of being informed of the fee (or within 60 days of denial of a fee waiver), the public body shall close the request.
existing_fee_payment_rules.trigger: 60 days elapse after fee notice or waiver denial without payment
existing_fee_payment_rules.clock_spec: 60 calendar-days from date requester informed of fee, or from date of fee-waiver denial; on lapse the request closes
existing_fee_payment_rules.source_language: If the requester fails to pay the fee within 60 days of the date on which the public body informed the requester of the fee, or fails to pay the fee within 60 days of the date on which the public body informed the requester of the denial of the fee waiver, the public body shall close the request.
existing_fee_payment_rules.notes: Terminal event (request ends). 60-day count is fixed by statute.
